chunks: 4242 - And ʿAbdullāh ibn Maymūn narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, عليهما السلام, who said:
The companions of the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله, at Tabūk, were drinking water in gulps.
So the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله, said: “Drink with your hands, for they are among the best of your vessels.”

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ: the companions or followers present with the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.أَيْدِيكُمْ: your hands, used here as a means for drinking
key_terms.بِتَبُوكَ: at Tabūk, the location where this event occurred
key_terms.يَعُبُّونَ: drinking in gulps or taking in water quickly

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله teach about drinking water with the hands?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that during Tabūk, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله directed his companions to drink using their hands. It conveys a Prophetic sunnah of simplicity and proper etiquette in drinking, presenting the hands as a worthy and natural vessel.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4242 - It is narrated by Abdullah bin Maymoon, from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
The companions of the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, were drinking water in large gulps at Tabuk.
So the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Drink with your hands, for they are among the best of your vessels."
